audience: NBFC seller CFO, treasurer, business head and operations lead
corePromise: Test, improve and prepare an admitted loan portfolio or compatible multi-seller analytical cohort before incurring full buyer-diligence and execution cost.

slides.title: Prepare the book before the buyer process begins
slides.purpose: Position AssureRail as staged preparation and controlled execution infrastructure for conventional direct assignment.
slides.proof: Automated Initial Assessment, expert-reviewed Portfolio Preparation, structured buyer review and coordinated closing.
slides.visual: Four-stage rail from admitted records to closing
claims: No guaranteed sale, price, timing or buyer approval.

slides.title: Subscale books lose time before they reach a bank decision
slides.purpose: Show the CFO problem: fragmented tapes, missing evidence, repeated questions, duplicated advisers and books below many conventional execution thresholds.
claims: Do not present any market-size threshold as legal, universal or accepted by a buyer class; validate current appetite for the actual opportunity.

slides.title: Declared corpus, transferable corpus and cash are different numbers
slides.purpose: Give the CFO an honest funnel for the live-style cohort: approximately ₹48 crore declared across 3–4 sellers, an eligibility range after screening, approximately ₹30 crore indicative transferable under stated assumptions, and seller net cash only after the full closing waterfall.
slides.visual: ₹48 Cr declared → seller-specific eligibility range → ~₹30 Cr indicative transferable → seller-specific gross consideration → debt release, fees and costs → net cash
claims: The ₹48 crore and ₹30 crore figures are illustrative planning assumptions, not eligibility, price, buyer-demand or cash promises.
Any minimum-holding, retention, permitted-transferee or other regulatory treatment must be confirmed with transaction counsel for the actual pools before use.

slides.title: Every exclusion should explain what happens next
slides.purpose: Classify screen-outs into time-cured, remediable and structural buckets so attrition becomes an actionable preparation result rather than an unexplained rejection.
slides.visual: Three-column exception register: time-cured / remediable / structural, each with affected units, reason, owner, evidence and next eligible review point
claims: Time-cured means the loan may become eligible later without corrective work, subject to the buyer's policy and counsel-confirmed rules.
Remediable means evidence or documentation can be corrected and reassessed; structural means the loan remains outside the selected transaction criteria unless those criteria change.

slides.title: Three or four sellers can prepare one analytical cohort
slides.purpose: Use the approximately ₹48 crore vehicle/EV example to show a common schema, cut-off, remaining-tenor band, evidence standard and buyer pack across roughly ₹12–16 crore seller books.
slides.visual: 3–4 seller lanes into a ~₹48 Cr analytical cohort and ~₹30 Cr indicative transferable view, followed by 3–4 separately controlled closing lanes
claims: The cohort pools analysis and buyer presentation, not legal ownership or transaction authority.
Each seller retains separate ownership, mandate, representations, order, invoice, consideration, settlement waterfall and closing.
Cross-seller borrower overlap is surfaced as concentration and potential double-pledge evidence for review; countable units are not deduplicated across sellers.

slides.title: Every admitted loan receives a recorded rule outcome
slides.purpose: Differentiate full-population computation from unexplained sampling.
slides.visual: 100% computational outcomes beside separately labelled CA, legal, field and technical samples
claims: Full-population does not mean every fact is independently verified or every file receives a separate legal opinion.

slides.title: Initial Assessment finds avoidable failure early
slides.purpose: Explain the paid, automated, unsigned first stage and what the seller receives.
slides.visual: Inputs → reconciliation → evidence gaps → risk/economics → remediation plan
claims: No consultant, qualified expert or human merit reviewer at Initial Assessment.
Three automated same-scope reassessments within 30 days.

slides.title: Fix the gaps and compare the next run
slides.purpose: Show affected loan–borrower pairs, owners, required evidence, corrected versions and resolved/continuing/new gaps.
claims: The workspace remains open; changed scope is requoted.

slides.title: Qualified review begins only when the seller proceeds
slides.purpose: Separate automated assessment from Portfolio Preparation with CA/financial and transaction-counsel section review.
slides.visual: Stage gate with reviewer signatures by section
claims: Asset, field or technical specialists are added only where the evidence or rule requires them.

slides.title: Buyer requirements shape preparation before formal diligence
slides.purpose: Explain post-MSA buyer profiles, record-level checks and traceable questions without implying purchase commitment.
slides.visual: Buyer criteria → policy checks → exceptions → buyer pack
claims: The buyer retains credit, legal, compliance, valuation, pricing and purchase decisions.

slides.title: Start with buyer classes that can assess the actual transferable size
slides.purpose: Present buyer sourcing as a validation exercise for an approximately ₹30 crore indicative transferable cohort rather than assuming a named bank or a large-private-bank ticket threshold.
slides.visual: Validate in parallel: small finance banks, old private-sector banks, relevant PSU-bank desks and larger NBFC acquirers; large private-bank outreach follows demonstrated execution or explicit interest
claims: These are buyer classes to validate for the actual asset, policy, timing and size; they are not commitments, rankings or statements of regulatory eligibility.
Do not name any institution in seller materials without permission and evidenced current interest in the specific opportunity.

slides.title: Cohort pricing follows countable work, with one minimum backstop
slides.purpose: Explain corrected countable units and how a formed cohort receives one fixed-stage minimum allocated into ordinary seller-specific quotes.
slides.visual: Committed: ₹500 per unique seller–loan–borrower pair plus ₹250 per unique loan–linked-party pair; standalone: ₹650 plus ₹325; compare aggregate unit charges with one ₹8L/₹10.4L cohort minimum, then allocate any binding minimum pro-rata by each seller's declared weighted unit charges.
claims: Each borrower and co-borrower creates a separate primary seller–loan–borrower unit; each guarantor, security provider or other separately linked party creates a separate loan–linked-party unit.
The seller is part of the primary key, so the same borrower in two sellers' books creates two units and is also flagged as cross-seller concentration.
The fixed-stage minimum applies once to a formed cohort, is allocated at formation, frozen in each seller's order and never reallocated because another seller changes scope or withdraws.
Every declared count or corpus variance is recalculated before formation; after formation, AssureRail bears cohort under-fill against the frozen minimum allocation.

For the illustrative ~₹48 crore cohort and ~₹30 crore settled consideration, combined standard core fees model at approximately ₹20.0–36.4 lakh (~0.67–1.21%), depending on the countable-unit mix; this is not a quote and excludes GST, optional services and pass-through costs.

slides.title: Execution fees follow successful seller-specific settlement
slides.purpose: Explain the seller-specific cumulative marginal schedule and the one cohort execution-minimum backstop.
slides.visual: 40 bps through ₹25 crore and 30 bps marginal above ₹25 crore on each seller's actual settled consideration; compare aggregate percentage fees with one ₹5L cohort minimum allocated by expected settled share at formation.
claims: No successful close, no execution success fee.
Actual seller share of purchase consideration settled remains the variable-fee base.
Any binding execution-minimum allocation is frozen at cohort formation and not reallocated; the cohort does not combine seller closings.

slides.title: Limited design-partner economics for the first two NBFC sellers
slides.purpose: Present the founder-approved offer and show the discount only after the seller's cohort allocation is fixed.
slides.visual: Standard seller allocation → independently approved 30% entity-bound invoice credit → discounted taxable fee; no reallocation to other sellers
claims: Subject to signed scope, independent approval and written eligible-fee schedule.
The design-partner discount applies after cohort allocation, so AssureRail absorbs any collected-total reduction below the cohort minimum.
Additional services, pass-throughs, connectivity, monitoring and contractor rates remain outside the current offer unless the quote states otherwise.

slides.title: Additional services are selected and priced separately
slides.purpose: Remove Bronze/Silver/Gold coercion and show check-box services.
slides.visual: Escrow/VAN coordination, counsel, CA certificate, bureau, registry, RTO/field work, SFTP, API and monitoring selection grid
claims: Routine managed services use published AssureRail customer rates; statutory and exceptional actual-cost items remain visible.

slides.title: Settlement remains with the appointed bank or provider
slides.purpose: Show separate seller-authorised distributions for debt release, service-fee leg, external charges and seller net even when preparation was pooled.
slides.visual: One analytical cohort leading to 3–4 balanced seller-specific waterfalls, VANs and acknowledgements
claims: AssureRail does not receive gross purchase consideration or unilaterally release funds.
A buyer may sequence the separate seller closings; one completed closing does not guarantee the others.

slides.title: Compare DA with the funding alternative using your own inputs
slides.purpose: Frame immediate liquidity/risk transfer against retained-spread borrowing economics.
slides.visual: Editable CFO table: declared corpus, eligible range, indicative transferable amount, seller purchase price, retained share, debt release, all fees, external costs and net cash
claims: Do not present an assumed all-inclusive 1.5% competitor route as fact.
Do not claim savings without a line-by-line comparable quote and seller-specific assumptions.

slides.title: Start with a paid scope and an honest data pack
slides.purpose: Close with the seller action: declare corpus, loans, borrower/co-borrower pairs, linked-party pairs, asset family, remaining tenor and evidence state.
slides.visual: Seller-level readiness checklist plus cohort roll-up and application CTA
claims: Commercial contracting and paid processing begin only after AssureRail Private Limited and live-readiness gates are complete.

PTC, tokenisation or Plaza as current Phase-1 availability

Treating declared corpus, eligible corpus, indicative transferable amount, gross consideration or seller net cash as interchangeable

Regulatory holding-period, retention, permitted-transferee or priority-sector numbers not confirmed for the transaction by counsel

Any suggestion that an analytical cohort legally commingles sellers or converts separate seller closings into one closing
